messages:
maya: Quick sync — need to finalize prioritization for inference perf work (latency vs throughput vs cost) before the Q2 roadmap commit.

maya: Customers: FinServX needs P99 < 200ms for chat; SearchC needs throughput for daily embedding batches. Also SME feedback: quantization regressions ok up to small BLEU drop.

maya: Proposed buckets:
1) Tail-latency (fast-path kernels, KV cache)
2) Throughput (batcher, worker autoscaling)
3) Cost ops (quant + caching + route cost policies)

maya: Asking for quick RICE-style inputs + estimated effort. Also add launch criteria (metrics + regression tests).

sam: For impact: chat product customers -> high. Reach maybe 40% prod traffic. Latency work is high effort (infra + kernel) but high impact.

irina: Agree. For embeddings throughput wins — reach smaller, but reduces infra $ by ~30% for batch loads. Quantization low dev effort but risk to accuracy; need per-model evals.

chris: Effort estimates: latency = 8w, batching = 5w, quant+ops = 3w (including evals). Ops needed: rollout policy + canary for each change.

devon: If we use RICE, I'd score (rough): Latency R:40 I:9 C:6 E:4 -> priority high. Throughput R:15 I:6 C:4 E:5 -> medium. Cost ops R:50 I:4 C:2 E:7 -> quick wins.

maya: Good data. Launch criteria proposals:
- Tail latency: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 250ms for chat routes; no >2% regressions on generation quality tests.
- Throughput: 2x throughput for batched embeddings with <10% latency increase for small requests.
- Cost ops: 20-30% token cost reduction on cold workloads; automated perf regression alerts.

sam: Note: cross-team blocker = kernel vendor support and infra quotas. Might need dedicated capacity pilot for latency work.

irina: Also add gating: perf harness runs on realistic traces, include sampled customer prompt sets.

chris: +1 to gating and canary windows. Marketplace customers may require private deployment checklist.

maya: Ok. Action: chris + sam + irina to produce one-page RICE table + effort table by EOD Friday. I'll consolidate for roadmap. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: perf-harness/weekly run started (job id: run-78421) - will post results when finished.
